body: Read SPEC revision 2 in full (495 lines, 35,983 bytes) and produced a breakdown for the user. No configuration changed.U+000AU+000AU+002A*SPEC survival status.** The file was still present at the originating session's scratchpad path. Copied to this session's scratchpad; SHA-256 `6c8388d7b7a044e01a756f81a37f877eedbe1b305b818fb65d0a944761403d6f` matches on both. That is a hedge only — both locations are session-scoped, so the open risk about losing the source of truth is NOT discharged. Landing it in the repo under a branch is still the first real action.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Two discrepancies found between the SPEC and this thread's completion criteria.** Neither is a defect in the work done so far; both need a decision before criteria are checked.U+000AU+000A1U+002E Criterion c4 checks `cat ~/.claude/rules/common/*.md ~/.claude/rules/common/git/*.md ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md | wc -c`, but SPEC section 8.5 omits the `git/*.md` glob. They also disagree in outcome: section 5.2 moves all three files under `rules/common/git/` into skills or the existing `pr` skill, so after application that directory is empty, the glob matches nothing, the shell passes it literally, and `cat` errors instead of returning a byte count. c4 should drop the `git/` term to match 8.5.U+000AU+000A2U+002E Checks 8.2 and 8.4 overlap. `does not survive` is a substring already swept by 8.4's alternation, so 8.2 proves nothing 8.4 does not. Harmless duplication, not a correctness problem.U+000AU+000ANo other inaccuracy found on a full read.
